subject: design/state-reader-v5
statement: State-reader-v4 is incorporated as a frozen conformance component at Git object `9a75b181b550d148b65fb7fd67d1d21558266e7f`. Its reader/budget decisions, port shapes, adapter behavior, storage/cutover protocol, all `DINV-1..DINV-13`, risks `R1..R8`, and acceptance `A-1..A-21` remain binding and executable without semantic change. The generated successor manifest pins that exact object and maps each carried anchor to the same named check/digest; a missing or changed mapping fails A-1 below. This successor changes only the Builds-on edge and adds §3's review-readiness composition.
